title: Extremely Loud Incorrect Buzzer
blurb: The EXTREMELY LOUD incorrect buzzer — the wrong-answer sound weaponized. It doesn't just tell someone they're wrong; it informs the entire building. This is the buzzer for confidently incorrect statements, terrible takes, and the moment someone says 'trust me.' The excessive volume is the entire joke. Warn your headphone users, or don't.
origin: The maximally loud edition of the game-show wrong-answer buzzer.
